transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [name]. What brings you in today?

I guess the main thing is my eating’s been off the past few weeks. I keep skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, and then even at dinner I’m just kind of picking at food, even when my wife cooks. My jeans are starting to feel loose, so I figured I should bring it up.
Have you noticed a decrease in your appetite or found yourself not wanting to eat even when you know you should?

Yeah, definitely. For the past few weeks I just haven’t really wanted to eat much. I’ll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without really trying to, and then at dinner I mostly just pick at it, even if my wife made something. My jeans are feeling looser too, so that’s what made me think I should mention it.
Have you noticed any unintentional weight loss lately?

Yeah, I think so. I haven’t weighed myself or anything, but my jeans are definitely feeling looser lately, and with how little I’ve been eating the last few weeks, it seems like I’ve probably lost some weight without trying.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight without trying over the past six months?

I’m not sure if it’s more than 5%—I haven’t actually weighed myself. What I do know is that for the past few weeks I’ve been eating a lot less, like skipping breakfast and lunch and then barely eating dinner, and my jeans are starting to feel loose.
Would you say you’ve lost more than 5% of your body weight without trying in the past six months?

I honestly don’t know if it’s more than 5%. I haven’t weighed myself. What made me bring it up is that the last few weeks I’ve barely been eating—skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, then just picking at dinner—and my jeans are starting to feel loose.
Have you noticed a loss of more than 5% of your body weight without trying in the past six months?

I can’t say for sure if it’s more than 5% because I haven’t weighed myself. It’s more that my eating’s been off the last few weeks—I’ll skip breakfast and lunch without meaning to, then just pick at dinner even when my wife cooked—and my jeans are starting to feel loose.
